catalog.candidate_policy: 旧词表并集所有保留的训练期正反馈商品；读取valid目标前固定候选文件哈希；旧索引不变

source_manifest.train_user_selection: bottom stable hash of train users with >=3 retained positive events; no valid information
source_manifest.eval_user_selection: bottom stable hash among train-eligible users with >=1 positive event in official valid; does not use target identity or coverage
source_manifest.candidate_selection: training-period histories of train/eval cohorts plus hash subset of train catalog; no validation targets added
source_manifest.target_policy: first positive in official valid among selected users; others outside this positive-event estimand
limitations: bounded candidate universe, missing targets retained as misses
eval cohort requires a positive validation event; not all-user traffic
source sequence truncation max50 means older positives unavailable for masking
metadata retrospective snapshot
source user-item dedup inherits upstream policy
